explicit_map_observations.authority_boundary_text_retained: Governance remains the sole semantic and decision authority for the published outcome. Ontology Lifecycle may record, order, replay, and project evidence of that outcome but cannot create, adopt, amend, revoke, invalidate, reinterpret, or enforce a Governance Decision. The Published Language and downstream Anti-Corruption Layer transfer information, never authority, ownership, admission, or permission.

relationships.authority_boundary: Governance remains the sole semantic and decision authority for the published outcome. Ontology Lifecycle may record, order, replay, and project evidence of that outcome but cannot create, adopt, amend, revoke, invalidate, reinterpret, or enforce a Governance Decision. The Published Language and downstream Anti-Corruption Layer transfer information, never authority, ownership, admission, or permission.
relationships.information_boundary: Governance publishes only an exact immutable owner-decision envelope: decision identity and version, decision kind, subject reference, source digest, authority scope, lifecycle or admission outcome, effective boundary, challenge route, and cited evidence references. Ontology Lifecycle may translate that envelope into its local Governance Event and Exact Semantic Event Reference records while preserving the exact upstream identity and digest. Missing, ambiguous, or unmapped fields become Typed Residue; mutable Governance internals, implicit classifications, credentials, and enforcement capability do not cross.

This relationship transfers immutable evidence and never transfers authority, ownership, admission, or permission.

relationships.information_boundary: Governance publishes only one immutable owner-decision evidence envelope containing exact decision identity and version, subject reference, source digest, authority scope, lifecycle or admission outcome, effective boundary, challenge route, and cited evidence references. Ontology Lifecycle translates that envelope into local Governance Event and Exact Semantic Event Reference records while preserving the upstream identity and digest. Missing, ambiguous, stale, or unmapped fields become Typed Residue; credentials, mutable Governance internals, implicit classifications, and enforcement capability do not cross.
